test.summary: SPM - OKR - Creating Text type custom field
test.description:
This test verifies creation of a Text type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Opening and validating the "Create custom field" modal
* Creating a Text type custom field with valid data
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field value can be set during OKR creation
* Verifying that the value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views
* Verifying that the custom field is available for all OKR types - Used-in (Strategic Theme, Objective, Key Result)

steps.action: Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-6117 SPM - OKR - Creating Text type custom field
steps.result:
Fields settings page is displayed.

The page contains:
Table with columns: Field name, Type, Used in, Description, Visibility
"Create new" button visible in the top right corner

"Create custom field" modal is displayed. The modal contains:

* Field name field
* "Type" dropdown with default value set to "Text"
* "Max length (optional)" 
* "Used in" section with selectable options selected by default
** Objective / Strategic theme
** Key results
* "Description"  field
* "Create" button (disabled by default)
* "Cancel" button

steps.data:
* fieldName: Text field
* description: new created field
steps.result:
Custom field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type, description and "Used in" values are displayed correctly

steps.result: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"

steps.result: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Custom Text field is visible in the right-side with correct value.

steps.result: Creation modal is displayed. Custom field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
